searchScope.candidateRules: Original-year case/witness terms; +/-2-day location/episode candidate expansion; undated explicit-name candidates retained for review. Similarity alone is not accepted identity.
searchScope.acceptanceRule: Explicit original case/witness/artifact/source-episode identity; primary retellings and contemporaneous reports allowed. Nearby coincidence, separate earlier/later encounters and comparative mentions are not original-case joins. Broad campaign entries require explicit named case-series evidence or upstream government-source survey attribution.
searchScope.limitations: One bounded full-corpus candidate pass with narrative/raw-field review. Not an external historical verification or deduplication study. No references means no confirmed identity found under these rules, not historical absence. Source claims, stored dates, served coordinates, and catalog-source multiplicity remain unchanged.
